Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen1:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.
If your POKéDEX has complete data on ten species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.
PROF. OAK entrusted me with HM05 for you.
So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.
Have you gathered data on at least ten kinds of POKéMON?
Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!
Congratulations! Here you go!
Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05:
HM05 contains the hidden move FLASH.
FLASH lights up even the darkest of caves and dungeons.
Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRo: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you can get through ROCK TUNNEL.
